english.note: Use this when stating explicitly and neutrally that someone has become pregnant, rather than using the colloquial 有咗.

examples.english: The doctor said she was three months pregnant, so they had managed to conceive three months ago.
examples.traditional: 醫生話佢已經懷孕三個月。
